subject: physics
content: A particle of mass m is moving along the x-axis with initial velocity . It collides elastically with a particle of mass 10 m at rest and then moves with half its initial kinetic energy (see figure). If then value of n is ________.
explanation:
......(1)

Also collision is elastic : ki = kf









By momentum conservation along y :

m1v1sin 1 = m2v2sin 2

mv1sin 1 = 10mv2sin 2

sin 1 = 10 sin 2

sin 1 = sin 2

n = 10
